pages.title: Doedicurus
pages.text: The Doedicurus ($(o)Doedicurus clavicaudatus$()) is an extinct glyptodont that lived in the grasslands of southern South America during the Pleistocene.$(br2)It was one of the largest glyptodonts, with a high, rigid shell of fused bony plates that could exceed a metre and a half in length.$(br2)Its armoured tail ended in a heavy, mace-like club of solid bone, making it one of the best-defended herbivores of its time.
